lines.en: the duration of the mean cycle of each planet, which in reality is of uniform motion, and they call it mean motion,

lines.text: کما ستعرف بيا بمدت دوره حقيقي انکوکب مسطور داشته و بجهته سهولت کسر انرا اسقاط

lines.en: consist of these durations, and no gross change occurs in these times except over long periods. And the intention of

summary.headline: Planetary Motions and Solar Months
summary.text: Chapter Four explains planetary retrograde and direct motions, mean and true cycles, and the varying duration of the Sun’s passage through each zodiacal sign according to the new royal Zij of Mashhad. It gives the Sun’s approximate residence in Aries through Pisces and defines the resulting true solar months.
